dataset_name: KiCad PCB 4-Layer Compact Optimization & Zero-DRC Training Dataset

stackup.L1_F_Cu: Signal / High-Speed Differential / Analog / Local Power / Solid Ground Pour with Thermal Reliefs
stackup.L2_In1_Cu: Continuous Solid Ground Plane (GND) with RF Antenna Keepout
stackup.L3_In2_Cu: Split Power Plane (+3V3 North Y:53-94mm / +5V South Y:94.5-128mm)
stackup.L4_B_Cu: Bottom SMD Components / LCD Bus Highways / 50-ohm RF Microstrip / Solid Ground Pour

remediation_stages.title: Baseline Spaghetti Routing Audit
remediation_stages.root_cause: Long power trunk lines running across surface layers (F.Cu/B.Cu) causing direct collisions with high-density signal tracks.
remediation_stages.remediation: Transition to 4-layer internal plane architecture: convert all SMD power pads to direct fanout vias into In1.Cu (GND) and In2.Cu (+3V3/+5V).

remediation_stages.title: Compact Placement & Planar Corridor Allocation
remediation_stages.root_cause: Severe track crossings in LCD 5-wire SPI bus (SPI_SCK, SPI_MOSI, LCD_CS, LCD_RST, LCD_DC) and USB Type-C differential pair near C_VBUS capacitor.
remediation_stages.remediation: Applied Planar Topology Embedding Theorem to order traces strictly from inner to outer corridors; segregated USB_D- (F.Cu North) and USB_D+ (B.Cu underpass).

remediation_stages.title: Boundary Halo & Local Pad Clearance Tuning
remediation_stages.root_cause: SPI_MOSI track at ESP32 East flank (Y=59.02) encroaching on U6.38 (GND) pad clearance halo (< 0.15 mm).
remediation_stages.remediation: Adjusted SPI_MOSI corridor to X=109.90 mm (providing 0.30 mm clearance to U6.38 pad edge at X=109.50) and shifted SPI_SCK outward to X=110.50 mm.

remediation_stages.title: Underpass Staggering & North Perimeter Routing
remediation_stages.root_cause: USB_D+ and USB_D- via spacing violation (< 0.15 mm clearance between 0.3/0.6mm vias) and VBAT_SW crossing LCD bus.
remediation_stages.remediation: Staggered USB vias longitudinally (D- drops via at X=95.80, D+ drops via at X=83.50); rerouted VBAT_SW to R_BAT1.1 along extreme North perimeter Y=52.80 mm.

remediation_stages.title: Golden Route Integration & Via Collision Audit
remediation_stages.root_cause: Co-located duplicate via at (119.6, 67.1), via too close to PTH pad 2 of J_BOOT at (121.5, 72.0); isolated zone island at R_FB2.2 on B.Cu, missing GND fanout vias at U6.15 and R_PROG.2.
remediation_stages.remediation: Removed duplicate via at (119.6, 67.1) and redundant via at (121.5, 72.0). Rerouted +5V feed to R_FB1.1 via direct via at (86.825, 108.0), eliminating 5mm B.Cu horizontal track and opening 2.2mm GND zone corridor to R_FB2.2. Added GND vias at U6.15 (93.69, 75.71) and R_PROG.2 (82.40, 99.15).

remediation_stages.title: Final 100% Verification (Zero DRC, Zero Unconnected)
remediation_stages.root_cause: None. 100% compliant with IPC-2221 Class 2 and KiCad 10 DRC.
remediation_stages.remediation: All 62 active nets fully connected; all 5 copper planes refilled without isolated islands; 0 DRC violations, 0 unconnected pads, 0 footprint errors.

Flaw_2_1.title: LiPo Leakage via Voltage Divider
Flaw_2_1.symptom: R_BAT1 connected to VBAT_RAW drained LiPo continuously when switch was OFF.
Flaw_2_1.fix: R_BAT1.1 reassigned from VBAT_RAW to VBAT_SW via North perimeter corridor Y=52.80 mm, achieving 0 uA shutdown leakage.

Flaw_3_1_and_4_2.title: MT3608 Boost Switching Noise & FB Sensitive Loop
Flaw_3_1_and_4_2.symptom: Switching spikes from boost power stage coupling into sensitive high-impedance pH analog circuitry.
Flaw_3_1_and_4_2.fix: SW_NODE routed short with 0.40 mm width on F.Cu (0 vias); BST_FB shielded and routed cleanly on B.Cu through quiet corridor away from D1 and L1.

Flaw_4_3_and_3_2.title: GPS 50-ohm RF Antenna Isolation
Flaw_4_3_and_3_2.symptom: GPS antenna line susceptible to cross-talk from noisy digital switching and TDS sensor AC pulse train.
Flaw_4_3_and_3_2.fix: GPS_ANT routed as 50-ohm coplanar microstrip (0.40 mm width, 0 vias) on B.Cu, isolated >= 3.0 mm from TDS_ADC.

Flaw_4_1.title: High-Impedance pH Signal Leakage
Flaw_4_1.symptom: pH glass electrode outputs pA currents; via leakage and surface moisture cause massive measurement drift.
Flaw_4_1.fix: PH_SIGNAL routed 100% on F.Cu without vias (0 vias), guarded by solid ground pour.
